title: Spirit
text:
Spirit is a resource that can be reserved to activate persistent buffs, summon permanent minions, and enable trigger meta gems. Characters have no spirit by default, though they can gain up to 100 permanent Spirit through quest rewards during the campaign. Otherwise, spirit is primarily granted by equipment and ascendancy passives.


== Mechanics ==
Persistent buffs and permanent minions that are granted by items such as sceptres or from ascendancy passive skills do not reserve spirit.


== Non-item sources ==


=== Quest rewards ===
These quest items grant permanent maximum Spirit:

Gemrot SkullGemrot SkullGrants +30 to Maximum SpiritThe skull of a stolen child, carefully cultivated by the Bog Witch...Right-click to break the skull and release the energies within.: +30 Spirit. Dropped by Ignagduk, the Bog Witch in The Azak Bog (Act 3)
Gemcrust SkullGemcrust SkullGrants +40 to Maximum SpiritThe mind springs forth eternal.Right-click to break the skull and release the energies within.: +40 Spirit. Dropped by Lythara, the Wayward Spear in Kriar Village (Interlude 3 - Doryani's Contingency)
